messages:
Ava Mendes: Heads up 11 Vendor: CloudSpendPro sent renewal with new 'priority ingress' fee and higher embedding rate.
Lucas Hale: ouch. paste the quote lines?
Ava Mendes: pasted:
```
CloudSpendPro Renewal 2026
- Enterprise base: $19,800/mo
- Priority ingress add-on: $3,300/mo
- Embedding unit: $0.0028 per embed (was $0.0020)
- No renewal discount quoted (term 12m)
```
Sofia Kim: IIRC we had a 10% renewal concession last year. Can billing confirm committed ARR?
billing-bot: Contract CSP-RED-2025: committed ARR $216,000; renewal credit applied 10%. Net invoiced 2025 = $194,400.
Lucas Hale: Can we ask them for: 1) line-item justification for new add-on, 2) month-by-month embedding usage for last 6 months, 3) reinstated renewal discount or a 2yr price lock?
Ava Mendes: yes. Also request a 30-day hold on pricing while we reconcile usage. Do not auto-accept addon.
Sofia Kim: If they won't reinstate discount, ask for a 6mo pilot of the addon or 25% discount on the addon line.
Lucas Hale: Draft email below, will send and cc procurement:
```
Subject: CloudSpendPro 1 Renewal questions and pricing hold request

Hi CloudSpendPro team,
We received the renewal for CSP-RED-2026 and need clarification before proceeding:
1) Please provide a line-item explanation for the new "priority ingress" charge and the billing metric used.
2) Please provide monthly embedding API usage for the last 6 months to validate overage calculations.
3) Confirm available renewal discounts for 12- or 24-month commitments and any migration/feature credits.
4) Please place the quoted pricing on a 30-day hold while we reconcile usage and contract terms.
We will not approve auto-renewal with the addon enabled without explicit written acceptance.
Thanks,
Lucas Hale
On behalf of Redwood Inference
```
Ava Mendes: billing-bot attach contract and last invoice to this thread please.
billing-bot: Attached: contract_CSP-RED-2025.pdf, invoice_2025-12.pdf :white_check_mark:
Sofia Kim: Quick calc: if addon stays, annual = (19,800 + 3,300)*12 = $276,600 vs net last year $194,400 -> +42% gap. Need to push hard.
Ava Mendes: Agreed. Target: reinstate 10% + remove addon, or keep addon with 20% discount on total.
Lucas Hale: Sending now. Will post their reply here.
Ava Mendes: Thanks all :thumbsup:
